title: Escaping the police by dragon
description: A dragon carries me over the harbour while squad cars keep pace on the wet streets below, searchlights swinging up through the smoke. It breathes fire down the avenue and nobody driving looks up.

title: Eggs rolling through midtown
description: Speckled eggs the height of the buildings come down the avenue and everyone runs the same direction I do. One of them grinds against a taxi and the shell holds.

title: Falling with no ground below
description: I fall backwards through flat grey light with both hands open, and nothing rushes past because there is nothing to pass. The light below keeps getting darker and I keep not arriving.

title: Lying in the grass
description: I lie on my back in clover while the sun comes up behind a city on the far ridge. The grass goes on growing past my ears and I decide not to get up.

title: The seagull wears a badge
description: A seagull in a police vest stands on a rock watching the traffic, and the ones circling above it are wearing caps too. The cable car goes by and nobody on it finds this strange.

title: Running from the investor
description: A man in a suit leans off a moving cable car with a mug in his hand and calls it a quick call. I run downhill past the red bridge and my backpack gets heavier every step.

title: Vegetables eating the forest
description: A carrot, a broccoli and a cabbage taller than the treeline are pulling up pines and eating them roots first. I am standing in the shallow water below where the forest used to be.

title: The cat walks me
description: A tabby the size of a bus walks me down a wet street on a leash while I keep up on my hands and knees. It does not look back once, and the rain never reaches its fur.

title: Sunbathing with an enormous head
description: My head has grown larger than the rest of me and I am on a striped lounger above the sea anyway, sunglasses on, chin up. The drink on the little table stays full all afternoon.

title: The memory vending machine
description: Every memory I had was stocked behind glass in a machine at the end of an empty street, and I stood there counting coins I did not have.

title: My shadow quit
description: My shadow stopped following me and walked off toward a skyline it clearly liked better. I watched it go and did not call after it.

title: Funeral for the last secret
description: A ring of men in coats stood around a small red-draped bier under a single thread of light. Nobody spoke, because there was nothing left that anyone did not know.

title: The sun waited for an apology
description: Dawn refused to come. Thousands of us knelt on frozen flatland facing an orange line that would not rise until someone said sorry to the night.

title: The universe at my front door
description: I opened the door and the universe was standing there dripping starlight onto my floor, patient, like it had knocked more than once.

title: Lunar Hotel
description: The moon was a hotel and every crater a lit room. I walked the grey plain below and could see people I have lost sitting at little tables.

title: The ocean drained overnight
description: The sea went out and never came back, and the city on the seabed woke up under a sunrise it had not seen in centuries. An anchor lay in the mud like a dropped toy.

title: A whale collecting unfinished conversations
description: It floated over the harbour with its mouth open and every sentence anyone gave up on drifted in, still glowing.

title: The buildings migrated south
description: Whole blocks tore free and flew, roots trailing, leaving the street I grew up on empty and wet. I stood in the middle of it looking up.

title: The train of other lives
description: Every station was a different version of my life and I kept leaning out the window instead of getting off. One of them walked into the gold city without me.

title: She called from the kitchen
description: My mother called me from the kitchen while she was standing right beside me with a finger on my lips. Something was still in there, waiting.

title: The moon hatched
description: The moon cracked open and pale spiders came down on threads a mile long, unhurried, landing all around me in the dark field.

title: Full signal, two percent
description: I woke in a coffin with perfect reception and a battery at two percent, and I could not decide who to spend it on.

title: My reflection smiled first
description: She smiled before I did, then slowly put a finger to her lips, and I understood I was the one being kept quiet.

title: The one mirror
description: Every mirror in the house showed an empty room. Every mirror except one, and in that one there was someone standing behind the door.

title: Knight of the sneeze
description: Every sneeze summoned an armoured knight who pointed at me and announced my failings to an empty living room. I had a cold for three days.

title: The murderer gave notes
description: He chased me through the park but kept pausing to critique my running form, sketching arrows on a clipboard. Honestly the notes were good.

title: Good boy, CPA
description: My dog unzipped his costume and revealed he had been a licensed accountant the entire time. He said he was done fetching.

title: Dance battle with the devil
description: The devil challenged me under a disco ball, lost badly, and then knelt there begging for a rematch while I kept pointing at the ceiling.

title: President of the pigeons
description: I was elected president of the pigeons and immediately introduced bread reform. The sash was heavier than it looked.
